import hashlib,json

b=Path("docs/experiments/20261009_live_camera_recording_30hz/native_deep")

r=json.loads((b/"tick_budget/analysis_receipt.json").read_text())

assert hashlib.sha256((b/"analyze_tick_budget.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r["script_sha256"]
for name,v in r["artifacts"].items():
 p=b/"tick_budget"/name
 assert p.stat().st_size==v["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v["sha256"],name
for name,v in d["source_inputs"].items():
 p=root/name
 assert p.stat().st_size==v["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v["sha256"],name
for c in d["cases"].values():
 assert abs(sum(v["mean_ms"] for v in c["stages"].values())-c["wall_stats"]["mean_ms"])<1e-9
 assert abs(sum(v["share_of_tick_percent"] for v in c["stages"].values())-100)<1e-9
assert len(d["source_inputs"])==14
assert len(d["cases"]["source-bound-identity-soak-12"]["over_30hz_budget_intervals"])==7
print("PASS: trusted inventory +14 frozen inputs +7 artifact hashes + script SHA + numeric closure + rare stalls")
